summary.zh: 起草劳动合同、录用通知与人事政策文件
summary.en: Draft employment contracts, offer letters, and HR policy documents

description.zh: 提供劳动合同、录用通知、员工手册和保密协议等模板，涵盖试用期、薪酬、竞业限制等常见条款。适合在为团队建立标准化雇佣文件时参考使用。各地劳动法差异较大，正式签署前应由本地法律顾问审阅。
description.en: Templates for employment contracts, offer letters, employee handbooks, and NDAs, covering probation, pay, and non-compete terms. Use them to standardize hiring documents. Local law varies, so have counsel review before signing.
